description: Creator & Brand Account Search: find creator and brand accounts on TikTok, Instagram or Threads by name or keyword. Only verified accounts or accounts with 10,000+ followers are returned (the rest counted in filtered_out); Threads search gives no follower counts and Instagram only for its first 10 results, so beyond those only verified accounts qualify. Per account the handle, name, bio, followers, following, posts and verification. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].
